name: SimInventoryActivationConsole
tagline: SIM and eSIM stock, activation and SIM-swap fraud checks in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete telecom SIM desk as one code component: stock per store with ICCID ranges, receive and transfer deliveries with Luhn-checked ICCIDs, activation with identity and number checks, and a SIM-swap desk that scores every request for fraud risk with security holds and supervisor approval. Works on Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Luhn-checked ICCIDs and automatic ICCID ranges
Receive stock ranges and transfer between stores
Reorder alerts for physical and eSIM stock
Activation with unique-number and identity checks
SIM-swap risk score with configurable signals
Security hold and supervisor approval for high-risk swaps
Grid with grouping, bulk actions, CSV export and undo
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (2 controls: SimInventoryActivationConsole data-set + SimInventoryActivationConsolePortal field)
